name: report_tree_by_sequence
note: AccountReport._order 'sequence, id' and root_report_id/country_id variants (addons/account/models/account_report.py): every report with its root and country, in display order
source_sql: SELECT id, root_report_id, country_id, sequence FROM account_report ORDER BY sequence, id

name: columns_and_sections_per_report
note: AccountReport.column_ids and section_report_ids (embedded column[] and sectionRel[]): column count and sub-report count per report
source_sql: SELECT r.id AS report_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_column c WHERE c.report_id = r.id) AS columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_section_rel s WHERE s.main_report_id = r.id) AS sections FROM account_report r ORDER BY r.id
